name: Tiko Write
subtitle: Trace letters, words and shapes
promotional_text: Free, calm handwriting practice. Letters, numbers, 51 shapes and whole words — including your child's own name. No ads, no purchases, nothing collected.
description:
Tiko Write teaches children to form letters, not just to colour them in.

Most tracing apps let a finger wander anywhere inside a letter-shaped hole. That teaches nothing about handwriting. Tiko Write follows the part a child cannot learn from looking at a finished letter: where a stroke starts, which way it travels, and which order the strokes come in.

HOW IT WORKS

A glowing dot shows where to begin, and arrows inside the stroke show which way to go. As your child traces, sparks fly from the tip of their finger. Ink is drawn along the letter's own line, so a wobbly hand still produces a clean letter — encouraging, never fussy. Finish it and the letter appears large, is said aloud, and the screen celebrates.

If your child strays off the path, nothing scolds them. The ink simply waits. There is no red cross, no buzzer, no spoken "wrong".

WHAT'S INSIDE

• Letters — A to Z and a to z, in a clean handwriting style with proper stroke order
• Numbers — 0 to 9
• Shapes — lines, circles, squares, zigzags and spirals for pre-writing practice
• Animals, Vehicles, Nature and Food — 38 pictures to trace, from a cat to a rocket
• Words — starter words in six languages, most matching a picture in the app
• Your own name — a grown-up can add any name or word

WRITING A WHOLE WORD

Words sit on a line the way they would on paper, and the screen slides so the letter in hand stays big and centred. A six-letter name is just as traceable on a phone as on an iPad.

BUILT FOR CHILDREN

• Free. No adverts, no in-app purchases, nothing locked away
• Nothing is collected. No account, no sign-up, no analytics on your child
• Works offline, from the moment you open it
• Six languages: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German and Maltese
• No points, streaks, timers or leaderboards. The celebration is the reward

Tiko Write is part of Tiko — a family of small, calm apps for children and the people who care for them.
